  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive Committee/Special

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Friday, May 10, 2024
  1:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  May 10, 2024 / 1:08 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis.

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Rodeo Drive Committee Partnership with Richard Orlinsky for “Rodeo Drive
  Celebrates” Public Art Display:
  a. The Committee is proposing a partnership between the city and Richard Orlinsky
  to display several pieces from August to November.
  b. While there is no fiscal ask for the city, they are asking to waive permit fees.
  c. The artist is based in Europe so it will take some time to ship the items.
  d. The installation of these pieces will coincide with the kickoff of the Rodeo Drive
  Celebrates Fashon event in early August.
  e. Promotion for this event will be done in close collaboration with the city, CVB, and
  the Chamber of Commerce.
  f. The bases for the pieces are evaluated by both the city’s plan review engineers
  and the public works engineer to ensure the safety of the structure.
  g. The bases are designed to be tall enough to prevent kids from crawling on them.
  h. Statures will be located at the intersection of the 400 block of Rodeo and S. Santa
  Monica, the intersection of the 300 block and Brighton way, and the intersection of
  the 200 and 300 blocks and Dayton Way. There will also be a statue at the Beverly
  Wilshire.
  i. The $200,000 cost for transporting the art pieces will be paid in full by the artist, as
  is any other expense related to this project such as the display banners.
  j. The permits required for this display require the artist to have both insurance that
  names the city as additionally insured as well as indemnification.
  k. The concerns about having kids ride the art pieces are due to aesthetic
  considerations, the bases are fully capable of handling the extra weight.
  l. The French Consulate is aware of this event and will be invited to events and
  additionally they will cooperate with the marketing and press release for the
  instillation.
